notes.title: Some quick fixes
notes.content:
Just some quick updates in addition to Pure Beat:

* Added mouse support for menus, and for the main game (leftcklick to change, right to drop, middle for super).

* All tracks can be played during Pure Beat. For standard play, they need to be unlocked through the campaign.

* Some bugfixes.

* Working on adding difficulty options to Pure Beat, and being able to map your own keys.

Ff you encounter any bugs, feel free to leave a note of it.
